sources.title: A combinatorial approach to density Hales-Jewett
sources.author: W. Timothy Gowers
evidence_supported: The open collaborative attack on density Hales-Jewett was explicitly launched on 2009-02-01.
The project was framed as a genuine mathematical research collaboration conducted through public blog discussion.

sources.title: A new proof of the density Hales-Jewett theorem
sources.author: D. H. J. Polymath
evidence_supported: A complete public preprint existed by 2009-10-20.
The preprint claimed the first elementary proof and the first quantitative bound for density Hales-Jewett.

sources.title: A new proof of the density Hales-Jewett theorem
sources.author: D. H. J. Polymath
evidence_supported: The journal received the manuscript on 2010-02-18.
The manuscript was revised on 2011-07-02 and accepted on 2011-08-29.
The article was published online on 2012-05-01.
The result was published under the collective author name D. H. J. Polymath.

technology_dependency.rationale: The internet-mediated public discussion was materially constitutive of the collaboration, but this record does not independently adjudicate whether the proof could have arisen through another organizational form.

discrepancies.interpretation: The seed value is the journal receipt date, while the public project launch occurred more than one year earlier.
The journal records 2011-07-02 as the revision date; treating it as verification requires an explicit coding decision.

remaining_questions: Reconstruct the contribution chronology from the original blog threads and project wiki.
Identify the earliest date on which the elementary proof was regarded by participants as complete.
Separate public preprint availability, journal submission, revision, acceptance, and publication.
Establish a defensible disciplinary-recognition date rather than using citation counts as a proxy.
